channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Pakistan suspends Iran border trade, amid violence on both sides
item.description: Islamabad cites security concerns, while Tehran points to technical issues as Pakistan mediates between Iran and the US.

item.title: Dozens killed after Houthi strike on military camp in Shabwa
item.description: Dozens of Yemenis are feared dead after a Houthi strike targeted a military camp in Yemen’s Shabwa governorate.

item.title: Russia’s Lavrov discusses US war and regional security during Tehran visit
item.description: GCC states have pressed Moscow to help halt Iranian attacks and reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Houthi attack on Yemen army camp in Shabwa reportedly kills at least 53
item.description: Rebel group reportedly launched ballistic missiles at camp in southern governorate during training exercise.

item.title: On Iran, Israel’s opposition is even more hawkish than Netanyahu
item.description: In rest of the world, the Israeli PM is often blamed for the Iran war. His opponents say he hasn't been tough enough.

item.title: Iran support for Houthis probed as Yemen war re-erupts and Saudi cities hit
item.description: There have been new reports of Iranian support for the Houthis in Yemen amid a wave of attacks on Saudi cities.

item.title: Deadly fire at Canada military base moved a kilometre 'in 30 to 60 seconds'
item.description: The blaze that killed four men and injured dozens of others spread with alarming speed, accounts suggest.

item.title: Bomb threat forces Israel to Austria flight into emergency landing
item.description: The Airbus jet landed safely in Bulgaria and all passengers and crew aboard were unharmed, officials said.
